hints.title: Retrograde Game State Induction
hints.text: Work backwards from known winning and losing states using game state degrees and retrograde analysis.

hints.title: Terminal Base Conditions
hints.text: The mouse wins immediately when reaching hole zero. The cat wins immediately whenever it catches the mouse at the same position.

hints.title: Degree Depletion Propagation
hints.text: Propagate terminal colors to predecessor game states. If a predecessor can move to a winning state, it wins. If all moves lead to opponent wins, it loses.

complexity.notes: Retrograde analysis across game states with degree tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard minimax recursion without cycle detection encounters infinite loops.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Degree dictionary and color table require O(N^2) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model state graph and apply retrograde analysis with in-degree counters.
